Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters and sort order every time you open a project, this one's for you. Saved Views let you capture exactly how you like to see your work — filtered, sorted, and grouped your way — and return to it in a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can set up dedicated views for sprints, priorities, clients, or personal workflows without worrying about running out of room. Need your teammates to see things the way you do? Views can be shared with your team, making it easy to align everyone around the same board, backlog, or timeline instead of re-explaining your setup in every standup.

Whether you're managing a single project or juggling several, Saved Views cuts down the busywork so you can focus on getting things done.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
